scope: Check whether the QtQuick6 attached ToolTip Window-role observation disappears when the KDE Qt platform theme plugin and session environment are enabled.
conclusion: The KDE QPA platform theme loaded a KDE palette and the seven hover targets passed. The QtQuick6 attached tooltip still rendered the Window background role rather than BreezeLight Colors:Tooltip. This rules out missing QT_QPA_PLATFORMTHEME as the sole cause; it does not yet identify which attached-tooltip component or Kirigami color-set path produced the fill.
source_observation: Installed /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/qt6/qml/org/kde/desktop/ToolTip.qml assigns Kirigami.Theme.Tooltip, but the probe could not read the attached object color-set/background through the current QML reference. Identify the actual loaded style component before changing product code.
limitations: One contrasting scheme was tested in this environment diagnostic.
Existing KDE TabButton null-y warnings remain unrelated to this target.
This does not establish a historical motif or user-acceptance result.
next: Instrument the attached ToolTip instance or use a minimal native QML probe to identify its actual implementation and effective Kirigami colorSet, then correct only if evidence shows the project preview bypasses the native Tooltip role.
